children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The sub-block with function 0x1E at 0x34B4 is not one WavPack defines, and it is not optional, so libwavpack refuses the block.
The optional sub-block with function 0x3E at 0x6010 is not one WavPack defines; decoders skip it.
